name: nchungdev-skills
description: Universal suite of 13 production-grade AI Agent Skills: GitHub Project v2 lifecycle & anti-rate-limit task workflow, FFmpeg media processing, TMDb catalog & franchise taxonomy, high-performance media ingestion, multi-target cloud/NAS synchronization, AI subtitle translation, distributed infrastructure & homelab operations, multi-conversation progress orchestration, autonomous system optimization & SRE diagnostics, zero-API cinema & series recommendation concierge, truth-seeking film evaluation & cinema auditor (Film Oracle), universal project conventions & skills bootstrapper (Project Bootstrap), and hardsub OCR extraction & subtitle synchronization (Hardsub Extractor).

plugins.name: ffmpeg-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive media processing engine powered by FFmpeg & FFprobe: Muxed subtitle stream extraction, zero-token voice activity alignment (VAD), and W3C WebVTT conversion with CSS tag sanitization.

plugins.name: tmdb-catalog
plugins.description: Cinema knowledge graph powered by TMDb API v3 & TheTVDB: Rich metadata, NFO generation, visual movie card rendering with small local poster thumbnails, season status tracking, and franchise classification (IP Universes, Auteur Collections, Studio Collections).

plugins.name: media-downloader
plugins.description: Universal media curation and high-performance ingestion engine: Torrent census & disk estimation, Prowlarr multi-indexer search, accelerated BitTorrent downloads via Aria2c RPC, and TorBox Debrid Cloud API.

plugins.name: media-sync
plugins.description: Media destination dispatcher and library standardizer: Normalizes Plex/TheTVDB directory hierarchies, auto-discovers NAS library targets via SSH, performs parallel high-throughput transfers to NAS (SSH/SFTP) and Google Drive (Rclone), and enforces post-sync auto-purging.

plugins.name: translate-subtitle
plugins.description: Two-stage deep neural subtitle translation engine tailored for cinema and anime: Preserves typography tags and timecode integrity while syncing with centralized glossaries (Subtitle Glossary Hub).

plugins.name: distributed-infra
plugins.description: Comprehensive self-hosted infrastructure and distributed compute manager: OpenMediaVault 7 NAS architecture, MergerFS storage pools, Docker Compose media automation, distributed Tdarr transcoding nodes, and ephemeral Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) integration.

plugins.name: project-reporter
plugins.description: Multi-conversation orchestrator, context synchronizer, and progress reporter. Eliminates context drift across concurrent chat sessions via a centralized ledger (.agent/project_status.json), scrubs secret tokens, and provides project visibility (report, report all).

plugins.name: system-doctor
plugins.description: All-in-one system optimizer and autonomous SRE diagnostic engine (CleanMyMac X meets Site Reliability Engineering). Auto-detects device signatures in 0.1s (macOS, Linux Server/NAS, Workstation) to clean OS/developer caches, purge RAM, kill runaway CPU hogs, hunt port conflicts, inspect Docker crashloops, and execute 1-click auto-healing.

plugins.name: media-advisor
plugins.description: Zero-API homelab cinema concierge: Reads local Plex/Jellyfin SQLite databases directly in read-only mode to analyze watch history, in-progress items, personal ratings, and unwatched library gems. Cross-references real-time theatrical releases, streaming drops, and community buzz with anti-seeding sentiment verification.

plugins.name: film-oracle
plugins.description: Truth-seeking cinema auditor and honest film evaluation engine. Synthesizes critic consensus, reviewer analyses, audience sentiment, polarizing flaws, buzz lifecycle timing, and demographic matchmaking to answer whether any film is worth watching.

plugins.name: project-bootstrap
plugins.description: Universal AI project scaffolding and cross-agent orchestrator: Generates tailored AGENTS.md conventions, scaffolds project-specific skills, and links them via relative symlinks across Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, and Windsurf.

plugins.name: hardsub-extractor
plugins.description: Autonomous video hardsub extraction and OCR alignment engine: Uses FFmpeg memory streaming and Gemini Multimodal Vision API to extract high-accuracy Vietnamese subtitles with exact timecodes and exports clean .vi.OCR.srt files.

plugins.name: github-project-workflow
plugins.description: Universal GitHub Project v2 lifecycle and task spec workflow engine with anti-rate-limit resilience: Zero-API local spec listing, persistent schema & item caching, 1-point targeted issue queries, and offline outbox mutation queue.
